system.description: Hoplosphere (Clot) — Nightglass. Distilled from the Hyde's tainted serum: a shard of night-glass that turns the beast's own darkness aside. While seated in an armor socket: gain Resistance to dark. Register: dark, Inanition aspect. Worth ~500z. Homebrew — this campaign only (Austin, for the Hyde encounter); NOT a Techno Fantasy Atlas owed sphere. The Resist-dark effect is applied manually by the GM/player; auto-applying ActiveEffect wiring is a post-Tuesday follow-up.
